retrievalProfile.description: A clean, cool-toned studio portrait featuring a subject leaning on a chair with asymmetric, lightweight geometric sans-serif typography positioned in the negative space.

recipe.visualDefinition: A medium close-up portrait of a male subject with spiky hair, leaning his chin on crossed arms over the back of a chair. The lighting is soft and cool-toned, creating a bright, slightly desaturated atmosphere. Typography is placed in the upper left quadrant, utilizing a thin, modern sans-serif font with varying weights and colors to create hierarchy.
coreVisualRelationships: subject positioned right-of-center to create left-side negative space
typography aligned to the left margin within the negative space
cool blue background tones echoing the subject's eye color
horizontal lines of the chair and arms grounding the verticality of the face
coreInvariants: soft studio lighting with minimal harsh shadows

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Subject occupies the right two-thirds of the frame, scaled from chest up.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The subject's eyes and the crossed arms resting on the chair back.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Starts at the subject's face, moves down to the crossed arms, then sweeps left to the typography.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Significant open space in the upper left corner to accommodate text.

colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Deep black and dark navy in the subject's clothing
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Muted blue and slate grey in the typography and chair
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: Low saturation with high value (brightness) in the background, contrasting with high-value skin tones and low-value clothing.
paletteRestrictions: Limit to cool blues, greys, and blacks

characterSpecificRedesigns: Lowercase 'a' is single-story and perfectly round
Lowercase 'y' has a straight, diagonal descender
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Weight and color contrast within the same font family.
graphicDevices: Color blocking within a single word to distinguish first and last name

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the perfectly round 'o' and 'a' and thin monolinear strokes.
Provides the geometric precision and tight kerning characteristic of the era.
Offers the necessary geometric skeleton and clean lowercase forms.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a studio portrait of a male subject with early 2000s spiky hair, wearing a black pinstripe shirt, leaning his chin on his crossed arms over the back of a light blue chair. Use cool-toned lighting and a pale blue-white background, leaving the upper left quadrant empty.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add two lines of lowercase text in the upper left negative space using a thin geometric sans-serif like Century Gothic. The first line should be larger, with the first word in a medium blue and the second word in black. The second line should be smaller and entirely black.

verificationChecks: Is the font a thin geometric sans-serif?
Is the subject leaning on a chair back?

adjustableVariables: Subject's hair style (while maintaining the era's texture)
Specific color of the first word in the title
mustRedesign: Do not use warm lighting (golden hour, etc.)

mustAchieve: Clean, sharp focus on the subject's eyes

postGenerationChecks: Check that the 'a' and 'o' in the font are circular.
Ensure the subject's arms are crossed and resting on a chair.
Verify the text is left-aligned in the upper left corner.
Confirm the color palette is strictly cool-toned.
recipe.reuseFormula: Cool-toned studio portrait + Geometric Sans-Serif (Thin) + Asymmetric Left-Aligned Layout = 2000s Pop Aesthetic
